assertions.name: bdh22_charts_are_minus1_twists
assertions.source: Both printed E2 charts and the E1 chart satisfy a_p = chi_{-1}(p) x (their conductor-50 partner) at all good p (asserted in-loop), and kraus_model(25,-1475) = kraus_model(145,2105) = None (no integral model, so additive at 2, conductor != 50). Finding: BDH22's printed chart equations are twist-sloppy (identified via j over C only) — no printed equation pins the Cremona label offline.

description: X0(50)/50a integer Hecke gate (uploaded-papers idea A4; filter 5 of the tau-dictionary gauntlet, composing with the W8 t5=-10 validator and the W8b Fricke/sign filters). From the task curve y^2 = x^3 - 675x - 79650 (j = -25/2 = j(5tau0)) the global minimal model y^2 + xy + y = x^3 - x - 2 (Delta = -1250, conductor 50: non-split multiplicative at 2 so a_2 = -1 and w_2 = +1; additive Kodaira IV at 5 so a_5 = 0) is derived offline by Laska-Kraus-Connell, and a_p for all p <= 50, p not dividing 50, are computed by exact point-counting (Hasse bound asserted per prime). Cross-checks: BDH22's printed E1/E2 charts are (-1)-twists with conductor != 50 (chart twist-sloppiness finding); the (-1)-twist of the E1 chart is the twin conductor-50 class (y^2+xy+y = x^3+x^2-3x+1, Delta = -800, split at 2) with a_p = chi5(p) a_p(E) (the Q(sqrt5) merge of BDH22); and on BDH22's own genus-2 X0(50) model (eq 10) the Frobenius trace identity t_p = a_p (1 + chi5(p)) holds at all 13 good primes (Eichler-Shimura), certifying {class(E), twin} = {50a, 50b}. WHICH of the two signatures is Cremona 50a is NOT decidable from the paper + offline arithmetic (the paper prints no equation for B/A4); both signatures are recorded and the single settling lookup is named (LMFDB EllipticCurve/Q/50/a). Audit-only; no fit; scope-(a).

caveats: Point counts and reduction data are exact and unconditional. The identification {class(E), twin} = {50a, 50b} additionally uses Eichler-Shimura (Jac(X0(50)) ~ product of the two level-50 newform classes) + BDH22's identification of C1 with X0(50); the 13-prime trace identity is the falsifier for that composite claim and it passes. Which class carries the Cremona LABEL 50a is a table convention not derivable from arithmetic; it requires the named lookup. Gate usage: a candidate W-plane family must reproduce ONE of the two recorded signatures exactly (integers, no tolerance); failing both = refuted-as-stated, scope-(a).
